lines.en: label day270:
scene norikomayaoffice1
: Hah...
I lean back in my chair and try to figure out what is happening to my life.
lines.zh: 我往椅背上一靠，试图弄明白我的人生到底在发生什么。

lines.en: And when I say “my” life I mean “Sensei’s” life because, as I was reminded via brute force yesterday, it is very much not my own.
lines.zh: 而我说「我的」人生时，指的其实是「Sensei 的」人生，因为昨天已经有人用粗暴的方式提醒过我了，这人生压根就不属于我。

lines.en: It’s one thing to have some girl randomly show up and talk about how she’s apparently known me for her entire life-
lines.zh: 有个女孩突然冒出来，说她似乎从小就认识我，这是一回事——

lines.en: But it’s another thing to proclaim her love for me in front of a room full of girls sliding down a slippery slope toward that same end point.
lines.zh: 但当着一屋子正沿着滑坡滑向同一个终点的女孩的面宣告她对我的爱，那就是另一回事了。

lines.en: The biggest surprise wasn’t that at all, though.
lines.zh: 不过，最让人吃惊的并不是这个。

lines.en: It was how Maya (Of all people) reacted to the whole thing.
lines.zh: 而是 Maya（偏偏是她）对整件事的反应。

lines.en: She didn’t even show up to[school] today.
lines.zh: 她今天连[school]都没来。

lines.en: And sure, it’s not the first time that’s happened...
lines.zh: 当然，这也不是第一次了……

lines.en: But to just chalk an absence up to coincidence after that outburst would be dismissing something anyone with half a brain would know is peculiar.
lines.zh: 但在她那样爆发之后，还把缺勤简单归为巧合，就等于无视了一个但凡有点脑子的人都看得出来的异常。

lines.en: According to Ami, she didn’t even get back to the dorm until late last night.
lines.zh: 据 Ami 说，她昨天深夜才回到宿舍。

lines.en: But is Noriko knowing me from the past really cause for such an uncharacteristic explosion?
lines.zh: 可是 Noriko 认识过去的我，真的足以引发那样一场反常的爆发吗？

lines.en: : Sensei~ This is your office, right?
lines.zh: : Sensei~ 这里是你的办公室吧？

lines.en: : It’s me! Noriko!
lines.zh: : 是我！Noriko！

lines.en: : The girl with the pink hair who asked you to wait outside the classroom only to have you march all the way down here without saying anything.
lines.zh: : 就是那个粉头发的女生，让你在教室外面等着，结果你一句话都没说就一路走到了这儿。

lines.en: : You can come in, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 进来吧，Noriko。

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice2
: Why, thank you for inviting me.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，谢谢你的邀请。

lines.en: : No problem. Sorry I didn’t wait for you. My mind’s been a little preoccupied over the last 24 hours.
lines.zh: : 没事。抱歉没等你。过去这二十四小时我脑子里一直有点乱。

lines.en: : I bet. Probably weird having me show up again out of nowhere and then saying all that stuff about being in love with you.
lines.zh: : 肯定的。我突然又冒出来，还说了一堆爱你的话，大概挺怪的吧。

lines.en: : A little bit, yeah.
lines.zh: : 是有点，嗯。

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice3
: Well, it was weird for me too! I don’t think I’ve ever cried in front of so many people before.
lines.zh: : 不过对我来说也很怪啊！我好像从没在这么多人面前哭过。

lines.en: : In fact, I can’t even remember the last time I cried in general.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我连自己上一次哭是什么时候都记不得了。

lines.en: : I’ve been saving all of my tears for the moment we reunited and they just kinda came streaming out all at once.
lines.zh: : 我把所有的眼泪都攒到了我们重逢的那一刻，结果它们就这么一下子全涌了出来。

lines.en: : I’m kind of excited to never have to cry again, though.
lines.zh: : 不过一想到以后再也不用哭了，我还有点小激动。

lines.en: : You are most definitely going to cry again at some point.
lines.zh: : 你将来绝对还会再哭的。

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice4
: Nope. No time for crying. Gotta make you remember me any way I possibly can.
lines.zh: : 不。没时间哭了。我得想尽一切办法让你想起我来。

lines.en: : Even if it means dressing up in clothes that are way too small for me and reenacting all of the time we used to spend together.
lines.zh: : 哪怕要穿上小得根本穿不下的衣服，把我们过去共度的时光一幕幕重演一遍。

lines.en: : I think the clothes you’re wearing now are perfectly fine.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你现在穿的衣服就挺好的。

lines.en: : Okaaaay~ But if you ever change your mind, just let me know.
lines.zh: : 好——吧~ 不过你要是哪天改主意了，随时跟我说。

lines.en: : Pretty sure I could act it out quite nicely since every second I’ve ever spent with you has been playing on repeat in my head since the moment we separated.
lines.zh: : 我肯定能演得相当不错，因为从我们分开的那一刻起，我和你共度的每一秒都在我脑子里循环播放。

lines.en: : It’s how I’ve kept myself sane all these years.
lines.zh: : 这些年我就是靠这个保持理智的。

lines.en: : Well, mostly sane.
lines.zh: : 好吧，大体上理智。

lines.en: : Pretty sane.
lines.zh: : 挺理智的。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Lots of people at my old[school] called me crazy because I would bring a pocket knife to[school], but it’s not like I ever stabbed someone, you know?
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。我以前那所[school]里很多人都说我疯了，因为我会带折叠刀去[school]，可我又没真捅过谁，对吧？

lines.en: : Do you...have a pocket knife with you now?
lines.zh: : 你……现在身上带着折叠刀吗？

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice5
: Just this little one for self defense. You never know when someone is going to pull you into an alleyway and tear your skirt off, you know?
lines.zh: : 就这一把小的，用来防身而已。你永远不知道什么时候会有人把你拖进小巷里把裙子撕掉，对吧？

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice6
: You can pull me into any alleyway you want, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你想把我拖进哪条小巷都行。

lines.en: : In fact, I encourage it.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我鼓励你这么做。

lines.en: : Are you even allowed to carry that with you?
lines.zh: : 你带着那个东西，是允许的吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Does it make you uncomfortable?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。让你不舒服了吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Please put it away.
lines.zh: : 是的。请收起来。

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice4
: Done.
lines.zh: : 收好了。

lines.en: : There you go. Proof I’m not crazy.
lines.zh: : 给你。这就是我没疯的证据。

lines.en: : I’m...probably going to need a little more proof than that.
lines.zh: : 我……大概需要比这更多的证据。

lines.en: : No offense, but everything you’ve done since coming here has been a little bit over the top.
lines.zh: : 无意冒犯，不过你来了之后做的一切都有点过头了。

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice7
: Hey, wait a second!
lines.zh: : 喂，等一下！

lines.en: : I’m not the one who freaked out and called someone a cunt in the middle of class.
lines.zh: : 在课上失控骂别人傻逼的人可不是我。

lines.en: : If there’s anyone who’s crazy, it’s Maya. Not me.
lines.zh: : 要说有谁疯了，那也是 Maya。不是我。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be surprised if she carried some sort of weapon with her too.
lines.zh: : 就算她身上也带着什么武器，我都不会意外。

lines.en: : Just...keep the knife in your pocket and everything will be fine.
lines.zh: : 只要……把刀收在口袋里别拿出来，一切就都没问题。

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice8
: Oh, I don’t have any pockets. And I don’t carry a purse either. So I kind of keep it tucked into the side of my underwear.
lines.zh: : 哦，我没有口袋。也不带包。所以我基本上是把它别在内裤边上。

lines.en: : This one time, it slipped out and totally sliced my leg wide open and all of the blood made people think I was on my period.
lines.zh: : 有一次它滑出来，把我的大腿整个划开了一道大口子，血流得到处都是，大家都以为我来月经了。

lines.en: : I’m fine now, though. And I heal quickly so there's not even a scar anymore.
lines.zh: : 不过我现在没事了。而且我愈合得很快，连疤都没留下。

lines.en: : Awesome, right?
lines.zh: : 很厉害吧？

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice9
: Oh my god I missed you so fucking much.
lines.zh: : 我的天啊，我他妈的好想你。

lines.en: : I still can’t believe I’m seeing you again.
lines.zh: : 我还是不敢相信我又见到你了。

lines.en: : It’s like...a dream come true.
lines.zh: : 就像……梦想成真了一样。

lines.en: : I can tell...
lines.zh: : 我看得出来……

lines.en: : I just wish I knew a little more about...well, what our relationship was.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望我能多了解一点……我们以前到底是什么关系。

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice10
: I’m actually your girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 其实我是你女朋友。

lines.en: : We have a house in Okinomiya and should get moving right away since I forgot to feed our cat this morning.
lines.zh: : 我们在 Okinomiya 有一栋房子，而且得赶紧动身了，因为我今天早上忘了喂我们的猫。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. And what was our actual relationship?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。那我们真正的关系又是什么？

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice11
: We were neighbors for a really long time.
lines.zh: : 我们做了很久很久的邻居。

lines.en: : Back when you lived in the old district.
lines.zh: : 在你还住在老城区的时候。

lines.en: scene yumis5
scene norikomayaoffice11
: You used to come over all the time. My parents really liked you, too.
lines.zh: : 你以前老往我家跑。我爸妈也特别喜欢你。

lines.en: : You were like another member of the family.
lines.zh: : 你就像家里的一员。

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice12
: What’s with that look?
lines.zh: : 你那是什么表情？

lines.en: : You know I was telling the truth that time, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道这次我说的是实话吧？

lines.en: : It seems that way, but...
lines.zh: : 看起来是，不过……

lines.en: : But what?
lines.zh: : 不过什么？

lines.en: : I’m just trying to figure out why I would visit a girl your age.
lines.zh: : 我只是想弄明白，我为什么会去拜访一个你这种年纪的女孩。

lines.en: : There has to be a good fifteen years between us.
lines.zh: : 我们之间少说也差了十五岁吧。

lines.en: : Hmm...
scene norikomayaoffice13
: Well you were at that age...
lines.zh: : 那时候你正好是那个年纪……

lines.en: : And we can’t help who we’re into, sooooo...
lines.zh: : 而且喜欢谁又不是我们能控制的，所——以呢……

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice14
: You were never there for me.
lines.zh: : 你从来不是为我而来的。

lines.en: : You came over to hang out with my sister.
lines.zh: : 你来我家是为了找我姐姐玩。

lines.en: : Please tell me she is an older sister.
lines.zh: : 请告诉我她是姐姐。

lines.en: : Of course she’s an older sister...
lines.zh: : 她当然是姐姐……

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice15
: But...after that...thing happened, you just stopped coming over.
lines.zh: : 可是……在那件……事发生之后，你就不来了。

lines.en: : Which no one ever blamed you for. It must have been really hard.
lines.zh: : 不过没人怪过你。那一定特别难熬吧。

lines.en: Thing?
lines.zh: 那件事？

lines.en: She’s talking about the accident, right?
lines.zh: 她说的是那场事故，对吧？

lines.en: The one that forced Ami’s parents out of this world long before they were meant to leave.
lines.zh: 就是那场让 Ami 的父母过早离开这个世界的事故。

lines.en: I’ve known this girl for that long?
lines.zh: 我认识这个女孩已经这么久了吗？

lines.en: : So, you haven’t seen me since that accident?
lines.zh: : 所以，那场事故之后你就没再见过我了？

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice16
: Hm?
: No, I saw you plenty of times after that. That was just the first time you disappeared.
lines.zh: : 没有，那之后我还见过你很多次呢。那只是你第一次消失而已。

lines.en: : I’m not sure how far back your memory goes, but you used to be a tutor.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你的记忆能回溯到多久以前，不过你以前是做家教的。

lines.en: : And my parents knew how much I liked you, so the second they heard about it from Nee-chan they called you and...voila.
lines.zh: : 我爸妈知道我有多喜欢你，所以他们一从姐姐那儿听说这件事就给你打了电话，然后……就成了。

lines.en: : Unrequited love began to blossom.
lines.zh: : 一场单恋就此开花。

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice17
: To be honest, I kind of hate myself for never even considering that you might have gone off and become a real teacher.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我从来没想过你可能会跑去当真正的老师，我有点恨自己这一点。

lines.en: : If I had known that, finding you would have been a million times easier.
lines.zh: : 如果我早知道，找你就要容易上不知多少倍。

lines.en: : Like, I know it’s only been a few years since then, but...
lines.zh: : 我是说，我知道从那之后才过了几年而已，可是……

lines.en: : I can’t help like feel it's been way...way longer.
lines.zh: : 我总觉得已经过了很久……很久了。

lines.en: : Almost like I’ve been searching for you for an eternity.
lines.zh: : 简直像是我找了你整整一个永恒。

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice18
: But I guess that’s just how everything feels when you love someone who doesn’t love you back, huh?
lines.zh: : 不过我想，爱上一个不爱你的人，大概就是这种感觉吧？

lines.en: Noriko remains quiet and stares at me for several seconds. Or maybe it’s minutes.
lines.zh: Noriko 沉默下来，盯着我看好几秒钟。也可能是好几分钟。

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: It’s kind of shocking how much this girl knows about “me.”
lines.zh: 这个女孩对「我」的了解之深，多少有点惊人。

lines.en: I don’t even think I’ve heard this much detail from Ami, and now I’m getting all of it just hoisted onto me out of nowhere.
lines.zh: 我甚至不觉得 Ami 跟我说过这么多细节，而现在这些全都一股脑儿地砸到了我头上。

lines.en: : Sensei...Even with how long it’s been, my feelings never changed.
lines.zh: : Sensei……不管过了多久，我的感情从来没有变过。

lines.en: : You stole my heart all those years ago and now I have to steal yours. It’s only fair.
lines.zh: : 那么多年前你偷走了我的心，现在我得把你的心偷过来。这才公平。

lines.en: : Good luck. I don’t think there’s very much left of it.
lines.zh: : 祝你好运。我觉得它也没剩下多少了。

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice19
: Ha! Now you’re starting to sound the same way you did back when you tutored me.
lines.zh: : 哈！你现在说话的口气，跟你以前给我当家教的时候一模一样。

lines.en: : But, I guess that’s also kind of depressing given the circumstances of why you began to speak like that in the first place, so forget I laughed.
lines.zh: : 不过，考虑到你当初变成那种说话方式的缘由，这也有点让人难过，所以就当我没笑吧。

lines.en: : I’m just nervous. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是紧张。就这样。

lines.en: A knock on the door interrupts the conversation and-
lines.zh: 一阵敲门声打断了我们的谈话，然后——

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice20
And Maya suddenly walks in.
lines.zh: 然后 Maya 突然走了进来。

lines.en: : Why knock if you’re just going to let yourself in?
lines.zh: : 既然要自己进来，干嘛还敲门？

lines.en: : Shut up.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。

lines.en: : Noriko, go home.
lines.zh: : Noriko，回家去。

lines.en: : But I don’t know which dorm I’m staying in yet.
lines.zh: : 可我还不知道自己住哪间宿舍呢。

lines.en: : Then sleep in an Internet cafe or something.
lines.zh: : 那就去网吧之类的地方睡。

lines.en: : I need to talk to Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我要和 Sensei 谈话。

lines.en: : Hmmm...
: How about we talk to him together? For old time’s sake?
lines.zh: : 要不我们一起跟他谈？看在往日的情分上？

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice21
: I’d rather drink bleach.
lines.zh: : 我宁愿喝漂白剂。

lines.en: : You had your turn for “office hours” and now it’s mine.
lines.zh: : 你的「办公室时间」已经结束了，现在轮到我了。

lines.en: : Now get lost or I’ll tell the principal you’re already infringing on[school] policy and have you expelled.
lines.zh: : 现在给我滚，不然我就去告诉校长你已经在违反[school]规定了，让你被开除。

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice22
: You’re...threatening to tell on me?...
lines.zh: : 你……在威胁要告我的状？……

lines.en: : How old are you?
lines.zh: : 你多大了？

lines.en: : Hah...Fine...Fine.
lines.zh: : 哈……行吧……行吧。

lines.en: : I have a shift soon anyway, so I have to get going.
lines.zh: : 反正我马上要上班了，得走了。

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice23
: See you in class tomorrow, Sensei~
lines.zh: : 明天课上见，Sensei~

lines.en: : Don’t have too much fun alone with Maya, okay?
lines.zh: : 别和 Maya 单独相处玩得太开心哦？

lines.en: : I rarely do.
lines.zh: : 我很少开心。

lines.en: : See you tomorrow, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 明天见，Noriko。

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice24
scene norikomayaoffice25
: You changed clothes.
lines.zh: : 你换了衣服。

lines.en: : I changed clothes.
lines.zh: : 我换了衣服。

lines.en: : Mind if I ask why?
lines.zh: : 介意我问为什么吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know, character development?
lines.zh: : 我怎么知道，角色成长？

lines.en: : What do you want me to say?
lines.zh: : 你想让我说什么？

lines.en: : Nothing really. You look cute.
lines.zh: : 也没什么。你看起来很可爱。

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : You should stop coming to[school] for the next two months or so.
lines.zh: : 接下来两个月左右，你不该再来[school]了。

lines.en: : Wait, what? I’d lose my job.
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？那我会丢工作的。

lines.en: : You’d get it back once the world resets. Consider it a vacation.
lines.zh: : 世界重置之后你会拿回来的。就当是放假吧。

lines.en: : It’s not a vacation if I can’t see you, Maya.
lines.zh: : 如果见不到你，那就不叫放假，Maya。

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice26
: Stop messing around! I’m being serious!
lines.zh: : 别闹了！我是认真的！

lines.en: : You’re always being serious. What’s so bad about Noriko?
lines.zh: : 你一直都很认真。Noriko 到底有什么不好？

lines.en: : I’m not going to just blindly do what you tell me if you’re not willing to explain yourself.
lines.zh: : 如果你不愿意解释清楚，我是不会盲目照你说的做的。

lines.en: : I don’t know how to explain myself, though! She’s not supposed to be here, so I never considered having to explain myself!
lines.zh: : 可我不知道该怎么解释啊！她本来就不该出现在这里，所以我从来没想过我还需要解释！

lines.en: : How is her appearance in the[school] any worse than Uta’s or Io’s? Or any of the other transfer students?
lines.zh: : 她出现在这所[school]，比 Uta 或者 Io 出现更糟在哪里？比其他任何一个转学生呢？

lines.en: : What’s so dangerous about me learning more about the old Sensei’s backstory when I’m so clearly not him?
lines.zh: : 我明明就不是他，多了解一些旧 Sensei 的过去又有什么危险？

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice27
scene norikomayaoffice28
: I don’t like her.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢她。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’ve made that extremely clear.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这一点你已经表达得极其清楚了。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize there was anyone capable of getting that sort of reaction out of you.
lines.zh: : 我没想到这世上还有人能让你有那样的反应。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...I didn’t realize the past was something I would ever have to confront.
lines.zh: : 是啊，嗯……我没想过过去这种东西我也会有必须面对的一天。

lines.en: : Spending so much time inside of loops clearly has some adverse side effects.
lines.zh: : 在循环里待了那么久，显然是有副作用的。

lines.en: : Let’s say for argument’s sake that you are not the “old” Sensei-
lines.zh: : 姑且假设你不是那个「旧」Sensei——

lines.en: : I thought that was pretty much confirmed?
lines.zh: : 我以为这一点基本上已经确认了？

lines.en: : Let’s say for argument’s sake that you are not the “old” Sensei- and your past was reintroduced to you by someone who just so happens to claim to know some aspects of it.
lines.zh: : 姑且假设你不是那个「旧」Sensei——而你的过去，是由一个碰巧声称了解其中某些片段的人重新带到你面前的。

lines.en: : In what way would that person’s words influence the decisions you make in your new, unrelated life?
lines.zh: : 那个人的话，会以什么方式影响你在这段全新的、毫不相干的人生里所做的决定？

lines.en: : They wouldn’t, really.
lines.zh: : 其实不会。

lines.en: : Then what can you possibly gain from hearing them?
lines.zh: : 那你听那些话又能得到什么？

lines.en: : The best course of action for you is to continue what you’re doing now- not looking too deeply into things and just...existing the way any other selfish, morally-inept person exists.
lines.zh: : 对你来说最好的做法就是继续你现在在做的事——别把事情挖得太深，就……像其他任何一个自私又道德无能的人那样活着。

lines.en: : You made it to winter. Do you have any idea how many “you’s” have made it to winter?
lines.zh: : 你撑到冬天了。你知道有多少个「你」撑到过冬天吗？

lines.en: : Am I allowed to find out or is that also part of your “stop looking into the past” thing?
lines.zh: : 我可以知道吗？还是说这也属于你那套「别去追究过去」的一部分？

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice29
: When do I ever ask you for anything?
lines.zh: : 我什么时候求过你什么？

lines.en: : You ask me to leave you alone pretty much every time I see you.
lines.zh: : 几乎每次见到你，你都让我别管你。

lines.en: : That doesn’t count. That’s how things are supposed to be.
lines.zh: : 那不算。那本来就该是这样。

lines.en: : When have I ever asked you to do something that I, Maya Makinami, am not personally at the forefront of?
lines.zh: : 我什么时候求你做过一件我自己——Maya Makinami——不是身处最前线的事？

lines.en: : I’m trying to preserve your life.
lines.zh: : 我是在设法保住你的人生。

lines.en: : Noriko can ruin everything much quicker than you think she can.
lines.zh: : Noriko 毁掉一切的速度，比你想象的快得多。

lines.en: : Huh...
: ...What?
: I’m just trying to figure out how you would know that if it’s something you never dealt with before.
lines.zh: : 我只是想弄明白，既然这是你从没经历过的事，你又是怎么知道的。

lines.en: : See?
lines.zh: : 看吧？

lines.en: : You don’t know for sure, do you?
lines.zh: : 你并不确定，对吧？

lines.en: : You’re just scared because the world isn’t something you understand anymore.
lines.zh: : 你只是害怕，因为这个世界已经不再是你所理解的样子了。

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice30
: You’re right.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。

lines.en: : I abhor the idea of admitting it, but you’re right.
lines.zh: : 我厌恶承认这一点，但你是对的。

lines.en: : Your sudden tendency to weave through failure unscathed is becoming more of a burden than it has been in a very long time.
lines.zh: : 你突然能够在失败中穿梭却毫发无伤的本事，正变成一种长久以来最为沉重的负担。

lines.en: : I’m very scared.
lines.zh: : 我非常害怕。

lines.en: : But I’d be a lot less scared if you ceased communications with Noriko.
lines.zh: : 但如果你能和 Noriko 断绝来往，我就不会这么怕了。

lines.en: : There. You got me to admit something.
lines.zh: : 好了。你让我承认了一件事。

lines.en: : Now you know how serious I am about this.
lines.zh: : 现在你知道我对这件事有多认真了。

lines.en: : Please.
lines.zh: : 求你了。

lines.en: I sigh to myself and get out of my chair.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，从椅子上站了起来。

lines.en: Never have I felt so far away, yet so close to someone at the same time.
lines.zh: 我从未如此同时感到与一个人相距如此遥远，却又如此贴近。

lines.en: It’s kind of like Maya is trying to prevent me from falling off a cliff by tying a blindfold around my eyes.
lines.zh: 有点像 Maya 为了不让我掉下悬崖，选择把我的眼睛蒙上。

lines.en: It’s not a solution, but it makes everything a lot less miserable and more...mysterious, I guess.
lines.zh: 这不是什么解决办法，不过它让一切都不那么痛苦了，而且更加……神秘吧，我想。

lines.en: But, inside of this makeshift metaphor, we don’t even know the cliff is a cliff yet.
lines.zh: 不过，在这个临时拼凑的比喻里，我们甚至还不知道那道悬崖是不是悬崖。

lines.en: It could be a diving board into a giant pool of money and pillows. And cake.
lines.zh: 它也可能是跳板，下面是一大池子的钱和枕头。还有蛋糕。

lines.en: It could be something wonderful.
lines.zh: 它可能是某种美好的东西。

lines.en: I am a man who understands the sheer harm that simply knowing something can cause.
lines.zh: 我是一个明白「仅仅是知道某件事」就能造成多大伤害的男人。

lines.en: But I am also a man who would willingly discard that knowledge as I am one who thinks with his penis just as much as his mind.
lines.zh: 但我同样是那种会主动抛弃这份认知的男人，因为我用阴茎思考的次数和用脑子一样多。

lines.en: More than his mind, even.
lines.zh: 甚至比用脑子还多。

lines.en: Noriko might be dangerous, and she might wind up revealing something that hurts Maya.
lines.zh: Noriko 也许很危险，她也许最终会说出什么伤害到 Maya 的事。

lines.en: But how often does Maya actually get hurt?
lines.zh: 可 Maya 真的受过几次伤？

lines.en: She’s blowing this out of proportion.
lines.zh: 她在小题大做。

lines.en: She has to be.
lines.zh: 她一定是。

lines.en: That’s all this is.
lines.zh: 事情就是这样。

lines.en: : Maya-
lines.zh: : Maya——

lines.en: scene norikomayaoffice31
: You don’t have to say anything...I can tell how you feel from your expression alone.
lines.zh: : 你什么都不用说……光看你的表情我就知道你怎么想。

lines.en: : You’re going to do what you want and don’t care one way or the other what implications it may have for the future.
lines.zh: : 你想怎么做就会怎么做，根本不在乎这对未来会有什么影响。

lines.en: : If it’s any consolation, you’re still my favorite shrine maiden.
lines.zh: : 如果这能让你好受点的话，你依然是我最喜欢的巫女。

lines.en: : Sometimes, forcing people to do things they’re not comfortable with is the best way to move them forward.
lines.zh: : 有时候，强迫别人去做他们不舒服的事，反而是推动他们前进的最好方式。

lines.en: : My own philosophies spell my downfall once again.
lines.zh: : 我自己的那套哲学又一次成了我的败因。

lines.en: : It’s not a downfall, it’s-
lines.zh: : 那不是败因，那是——

lines.en: : It’s a spiral.
lines.zh: : 那是螺旋。

lines.en: : I’m going home now.
lines.zh: : 我要回家了。

lines.en: scene black
I watch as Maya leaves the room.
lines.zh: 我看着 Maya 离开了房间。

lines.en: When she reaches for the handle, it’s the closest I’ve ever seen her hands to shaking.
lines.zh: 她伸手去够门把的时候，那双手是我见过最接近颤抖的一次。

lines.en: I’m sure she’ll be fine.
lines.zh: 我相信她会没事的。

Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!
lines.zh: Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]！
